name: Erlebnisberg Achensee
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnisberg Rofan at Lake Achensee: Rofanseilbahn cable car to 1,840 m, spectacular AIRROFAN skyglider, Adlerhorst viewing platform, and a climbing paradise.
preis: Berg- und Talfahrt Erwachsene 30,50 €, Kinder 18,50 €; Flug ab 18,00 €
oeffnungszeiten: Ende April bis Anfang Nov täglich 08:30–17:00 Uhr (Hochsommer ab 08:00 Uhr)
beschreibung:
Overview

The Erlebnisberg Rofan (listed in the database as Erlebnisberg Achensee) rises directly above Maurach on the eastern shore of Lake Achensee. Made accessible by the tradition-rich Rofan cable car, the lift carries nature lovers from 980 metres above sea level to the sunny mountain plateau at 1,840 metres in just a few minutes. Nestled between the rock walls of the Rofan mountains and the deep view down to the 'Tyrolean Sea', the area offers a successful symbiosis of scenic alpine hikes, demanding via ferratas and innovative flying attractions.

History & Attractions

The history of alpine development began on 1 July 1959 with the ceremonial opening of the two-cable aerial tramway, which has since brought generations of summer visitors up into the high mountains; in 2016 the entire cable car technology was comprehensively refurbished. The absolute trademark of the adventure mountain is the AIRROFAN Skyglider installed in 2007: the spectacular flying device shaped like a mighty eagle pulls up to four people, secured face-down, more than 200 metres of altitude backwards up to the Gschöllkopf, before the eagle releases and hurtles downhill at an intoxicating speed of over 80 km/h. On the 2,039-metre-high summit of the Gschöllkopf, the 'Adlerhorst' viewing platform sits enthroned – a 15-tonne, circular iron construction by the Tyrolean blacksmith Manfred Hörl, modelled on a giant eagle's nest and opening up a breathtaking 360-degree panorama over Lake Achensee, the Karwendel, the Zillertal Alps and the Inn valley. Climbers also appreciate the famous 5-summit via ferrata, which connects five striking Rofan peaks.

Visit & Getting There

The Rofan cable car operates in the summer season from the end of April to the beginning of November daily from 08:30 to 17:00 (in high summer from 08:00 to 17:30). In winter the ski season runs from mid-December to the end of March. The AIRROFAN Skyglider starts in suitable weather daily from 09:00 to 16:15. Cable car prices Summer 2025/2026: return ticket for adults 30.50 €, children (born 2011–2019) 18.50 €, children under 6 years ride free. Single AIRROFAN flight: adults 18.00 €, children 12.50 € (requirement: at least 10 years old and 1.30 m tall). Access to the Adlerhorst viewing platform is free. Getting there by public transport: ÖBB to Jenbach station, from there take bus line 4080 every half hour directly to the Maurach Rofanseilbahn stop in front of the valley station. By car: Inntal motorway A12, exit Wiesing/Achensee, B181 to Maurach (Achenseestraße 10, large car park at the valley station).

Tips

The valley and mountain stations of the cable car as well as the mountain restaurant at the mountain station (Erfurter Hütte) are accessible without steps and suitable for wheelchairs; large cabins easily accommodate wheelchairs and prams. (Please note: the alpine trail from the mountain station up to the Adlerhorst overcomes around 200 metres of altitude over rock steps and is not barrier-free). Visit the Adlerhorst on clear mornings to enjoy the best distant views.
